question:
Direction: Read the sentence to find out whether there is any error in it. The error, if any, will be in one part of the sentence.

**It had asked the Centre/ to step in and clarify in an affidavit/ what it intend to do to curb compulsory/ or deceitful religious conversions.**

options.text: what it intend to do to curb compulsory
to step in and clarify in an affidavit

solution:
The correct option is **"option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The error lies in option 2 of the sentence.
 
• Here, we can use "intended" in place of "intend" to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• In Subject-verb agreement, we use a singular verb with a singular noun or pronoun or do **verb change** as per the **tense **and a plural verb with a plural noun or pronoun.
 
 
• ​Example:* **Hina read a book fluently *
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "it" is a singular pronoun and we use the verb's 2nd form **"intended"** as the sentence is in the **past tense.**
 
• So, we replace the plural verb "intend" with the verb's 2nd form "intended" to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• All the other options are correct.

Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

 Correct sentence__:* **It had asked the Centre/ to step in and clarify in an affidavit/ **what it __intended__ to do to curb compulsory/ **or deceitful religious conversions.*
